game: Grand Theft Auto III - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: Total story missions
findings.detail: 50 storyline missions (Give Me Liberty through The Exchange). Wiki lists 51 entries if the Introduction cutscene is counted. Portland 22 + Intro (23 entries), Staunton Island 27, Shoreside Vale 1. Total 75 'missions' including 17 phone, 4 off-road, 4 RC (the 4 vehicle sub-missions are separate).
findings.trackable: Unconfirmed that a story-mission counter is displayed (see gaps).

findings.name: Portland - intro
findings.detail: Introduction, Give Me Liberty, Luigi's Girls (no external giver)

findings.name: Portland - Luigi Goterelli (4)
findings.detail: Don't Spank Ma Bitch Up, Drive Misty For Me, Pump-Action Pimp, The Fuzz Ball

findings.name: Portland - Joey Leone (6)
findings.detail: Mike Lips Last Lunch, Farewell 'Chunky' Lee Chong, Van Heist, Cipriani's Chauffeur, Dead Skunk in the Trunk, The Getaway

findings.name: Portland - Toni Cipriani / Salvatore Leone / 8-Ball
findings.detail: Toni: Taking Out the Laundry, The Pick-Up, Salvatore's Called a Meeting. Salvatore: Chaperone. Toni: Triads and Tribulations, Blow Fish. Salvatore: Cutting the Grass, Bomb Da Base: Act I. 8-Ball: Bomb Da Base: Act II. Salvatore: Last Requests (unlocks Staunton Island; Claude escapes with Maria and Asuka).

findings.name: Staunton Island - Asuka Kasen (5, then 3-4 later)
findings.detail: First: Sayonara Salvatore, Under Surveillance, Paparazzi Purge, Payday For Ray, Two-Faced Tanner. Later: Bait, Espresso-2-Go!, S.A.M. (Ransom giver: gta.wiki says Catalina; grandtheftwiki grouped it under Asuka).

findings.name: Staunton Island - Kenji Kasen (5)
findings.detail: Kanbu Bust-out, Grand Theft Auto, Deal Steal, Shima, Smack Down

findings.name: Staunton Island - Ray Machowski (5, then 1)
findings.detail: Silence the Sneak, Arms Shortage, Evidence Dash, Gone Fishing, Plaster Blaster; later Marked Man

findings.name: Staunton Island - Donald Love (7)
findings.detail: Liberator, Waka-Gashira Wipeout!, A Drop in the Ocean, Grand Theft Aero, Escort Service, Decoy, Love's Disappearance

findings.name: Shoreside Vale - Catalina (1)
findings.detail: The Exchange is the ONLY story mission on Shoreside Vale and the final mission. Kingdom Come, Uzi Rider, Bling-bling Scramble, Gangcar Round-up (King Courtney) and Uzi Money, Toyminator, Rigged to Blow, Bullion Run, Rumble (D-Ice) are phone missions, not story.

findings.name: The Exchange
findings.detail: Claude collects ransom for kidnapped Maria, Catalina double-crosses him and flees with money; Claude escapes the Cartel stronghold, rescues Maria, shoots down Catalina's getaway helicopter. Maria is then silenced by a gunshot (ambiguous who fired).

findings.name: 10 missable missions (order dependent)
findings.detail: Finish Joey's and Luigi's missions before Last Requests; finish Kenji Kasen missions before Waka-Gashira Wipeout!; finish Two-Faced Tanner before Grand Theft Aero. Side content also gets harder as gangs turn hostile.

findings.name: 100% completion
findings.detail: Requires 50 story missions, 17 phone missions (El Burro, Marty Chonks, King Courtney, D-Ice), 4 vehicle missions (Firefighter 60 fires, Paramedic level 12, Taxi 100 fares, Vigilante 60 criminals), 4 off-road, 4 RC, 3 Import/Export lists, 20 rampages, 20 unique stunt jumps, 100 hidden packages. Existing trophy/achievement 'Is That All You've Got?' awards 100%.

trackableStats.where: Pause Menu > Stats (Steam user says first line)

versionNotes.note: No Switch-specific story differences found. Existing trophy/achievement for 100% is 'Is That All You've Got?'. A glitch: Purple Nines absence after 'Rumble' can carry over and block 100% (PC reports); 'Kingdom Come' as last objective may fail to trigger the achievement.

gaps: Could not confirm the Stats screen shows a count of story missions passed (a Steam user says Stats shows 'principal missions missing' after ending, suggesting a separate story counter, unverified).
Did not verify the Switch version specifically, nor which of the 10 missable missions are which.
Ransom giver conflict: gta.wiki says Catalina, grandtheftwiki groups under Asuka.
Whether Introduction counts as mission: 50 vs 51 depends on source; 3djuegos/bloxodes give different totals (68, 89) due to counting side missions.
Did not confirm the Definitive Edition retained mission names/order exactly (assumed unchanged).
